contact_classroom_intake_handoff_api_int: The contact API normalizes the incoming intent before rebuilding the classroom inquiry payload.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_classro: The classroom contact route keeps the inquiry focused on teacher, tutor, parent, or school workflows.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_client_: The client submits the normalized classroomInquiry object alongside the contact message without creating classroom records.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_contact: The classroom inquiry route is the explicit /contact?subject=classroom entry point instead of a generic contact form.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_descrip: A 30-slice classroom inquiry intake contract for turning teacher context into safe support email context without creating activities, assignment links, student records, or learner notifications.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_email_f: The email field is used for support follow-up and is not displayed inside the public intake handoff.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_email_t: The contact email template renders the structured classroom fields as a separate classroom inquiry block.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_field_l: Learners and grade fields stop at {learnersLimit}/{gradeLimit} characters; material, routine, and need fields stop at {materialLimit}/{routineLimit}/{needLimit} characters.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_field_n: Structured classroom fields are normalized with NFKC, collapsed whitespace, trimming, and field-specific length limits.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_form_re: The form renders learners, grade, material, routine, and need fields separately from the free-text message.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_grade_f: The grade field keeps class level context separate from learner count so support can suggest age-appropriate templates.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_inquiry: The route renders the classroom inquiry panel so teachers see activity, assignment, attempt, and results context before writing support text.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_legacy_: The intake copy stays in ClassGamify classroom terms and avoids copied starter, unrelated learning-site, or generic SaaS wording.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_locale_: The current request locale is forwarded into the contact email so support context and labels stay localized.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_mail_co: Structured classroom fields are passed into the contact email template separately from the free-text message.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_message: The free-text message can add timeline, constraints, or product questions without replacing the structured classroom fields.
The classroom message starts with prompts for learners, grade, material, weekly routine, template or result need, and timeline.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_name_fi: The name field identifies who is asking for classroom support without becoming a student record.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_no_acti: The intake path does not create, edit, archive, duplicate, publish, close, or reopen teacher activities or assignments.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_no_stud: The intake path never sends student or learner notifications and only prepares support email context.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_private: The intake handoff does not expose raw student identifiers, source-material storage keys, private file URLs, provider errors, or file bytes.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_scope_f: Scope items map back to structured field ids ({fieldIds}) instead of free-form support-only text.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_scope_p: The classroom scope panel contributes {scopeItemCount} safe scope items before the message is sent.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_server_: The contact server function rebuilds and normalizes classroomInquiry from accepted field ids before mail context is created.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_structu: The form sends a classroomInquiry payload so support can inspect learner, grade, material, routine, and need fields without parsing free text.
contact_classroom_intake_handoff_subject: The classroom route uses the classroom support subject for both mailto links and form intent.
